func_080073BC_6C6B0C.title: Update the idle Meat Hammer pickup
func_080073BC_6C6B0C.summary: Rotates the Meat Hammer equipment pickup and starts its native acquisition scenario when local player contact is reported.

parameters.name: task
parameters.description: Initialized File30 entity 0x3D2 task in room 0x62.

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: The native object stored at task +0x18.

behavior: Each normal update adds 4 to object yaw halfword +0x16, masked to 0x3FF.

Task status word +0x68 bit 0x200 admits the local acquisition branch. It acquires local player control, starts scenario 0x86, and sets collection flag 0x1A6. The idle callback does not reread that flag.
The acquisition branch disables the attack shape, hides the root, creates its native local poof and sets byte +0xD0 of the shine child linked at root +0xE4.
The task then installs func_08007494_6C6BE4. That continuation waits for the scenario to finish before releasing local control. It must remain scheduled for a pickup that has already begun.
The constructor tests collection flag 0x1A6 before creating the equipment and its shine. The flag controls whether a new root should appear; it is separate from the scenario continuation.
cautions: Do not replay this callback for visual catch-up: its contact branch changes progression, allocates effects and acquires player control.
Keep task pointers, shine pointers and scenario/control ownership local. An already-collected flag alone does not prove the active local scenario has finished.
Fire Ryo is the equipment upgrade; this collection flag does not encode the current ryo balance.
func_080073BC_6C6B0C.exampleExplanation: The entry hook observes yaw without running the native acquisition branch a second time.

func_80218DA8_5D4278.title: Set an actor attack cylinder
func_80218DA8_5D4278.summary: Stores a cylinder-style attack shape using a signed radius input scaled by ten, a height and a vertical offset.
func_80218DA8_5D4278.declaration: extern void func_80218DA8_5D4278(void *task, int radius_times_ten, unsigned short height, short offset);

parameters.name: radius_times_ten
parameters.description: Signed radius numerator; native signed division by 10 precedes the halfword store.

behavior: Writes 0xFFFFFFFF to task word +0x48 to select this shape representation.
Stores the low halfword of signed radius_times_ten / 10 at +0x4E, height at +0x50 and offset at +0x52. It makes no calls.
Equipment constructors pass (500,25,0), producing radius50. Their acquisition branches pass (0,0,0) to disable the shape.
cautions: The radius argument is a signed 32-bit integer, not a pre-scaled halfword.
This setter changes shape data; it does not perform a contact or damage pass and does not clear previously latched task contact status.
func_80218DA8_5D4278.exampleExplanation: Use on an initialized actor when its own lifecycle has ended attack admission. Previously latched contact remains a separate concern.

func_802139E0_5CEEB0.title: Initialize an equipment shine child
func_802139E0_5CEEB0.summary: Binds the native billboard shine model and looping texture animation for an already-allocated child task.
behavior: The effect allocator selects this initializer for its category13 shine branch. The child starts with inherited entity identity and generation.

Sets model1 and task flags0x22A, binds static slot5 and billboard state, and starts texture clip1 at rate0.5 with looping enabled. It sets byte+D5 to1, adds task flags+64 bit2, and installs func_80213A9C_5CEF6C.
The initializer does not clear byte+D0, the continuation termination signal.
cautions: Only the native constructor path should initialize this child. Replaying it may rebind resources and reset the local visual state.
The parent-to-child pointer is local and can become stale after task-slot reuse; entity, generation, object and callback identity must be checked before accessing a linked child.
func_802139E0_5CEEB0.exampleExplanation: Observes the termination byte at entry without clearing it or replaying construction.

func_80213A9C_5CEF6C.title: Animate and retire an equipment shine
func_80213A9C_5CEF6C.summary: Advances local shine color state and deletes the current effect task when its termination byte is nonzero.
behavior: Updates the shine using its local color/cycle bytes +0xD4 and +0xD5.
A nonzero byte at task +0xD0 triggers deletion through the current-task lifecycle. Equipment pickup callbacks signal this byte on their own shine.
cautions: This continuation depends on the current scheduled task. Do not call it directly to retire a different effect.
Preserve local color and texture-animation state; the termination byte is a lifecycle signal, not an animation phase.
func_80213A9C_5CEF6C.exampleExplanation: The normal scheduler still performs animation and deletion once.

func_080018E4_6EAA34.title: Advance a giant spinning top
func_080018E4_6EAA34.summary: Advances the top yaw and cosine travel phase from immutable placement parameters.
behavior: Adds4 to yaw halfword+0x16 and masks to0x3FF. Subtypes0/1 set X=originX+cos(phase)*radius; subtypes2/3 set Z=originZ+cos(phase)*radius. It then adds the signed low halfword of step to phase and masks to0x3FF.
Task words+D0/+D4/+D8 hold immutable subtype/radius/step. Floats+DC/+E0 hold initial X/Z. Unsigned halfword+E4 holds the travel phase. The constructor starts phase0 for subtypes0/2 and0x200 for1/3.
All seven placed tops use subtype/radius/step (2,160,1), (3,160,1), (0,130,2) or (0,80,4). The first two occur in room0x3E and the latter two in room0x3F.
The constructor binds static slot0 of model0x365 with primary0x1E9, secondary0x168 and common0x152, command0x48000348 and uniform scale0.1. No animation clock drives the motion.
The only called helper is native cosine. This continuation has no child allocation, player mutation, sound, reward or damage dispatch.

Both mechanism constructors set task flags+64 bit0x4000. The separately scheduled native common post owns support/contact behavior and moves only the local player whose support pointer names this object.
cautions: Use the full File40 ROM-qualified symbol and initialized resident resources. A static model still owns local command/resource pointers.
Each invocation advances motion. Observation hooks must not call the continuation again or replay the constructor.
Do not duplicate the common post or copy another player's support pointer.
func_080018E4_6EAA34.exampleExplanation: Samples yaw at the normal callback boundary; native motion and local contact remain scheduled once.

func_08001CC4_6EAE14.summary: Advances the platform yaw by two native angle units in its configured direction.
behavior: Reads immutable task word+D0. Zero subtracts2 from yaw; nonzero adds2. The result is masked to0x3FF. The complete callback makes no calls.
All five placements are in room0x3F and use direction0 or1. Initial yaw is0 or0x200.
